title: Clinical Provider - AU (Karratha / Mandurah / Geraldton)
description:
About Intellect
At Intellect, we’re a leading global mental health tech company in 100+ markets worldwide. We partner with employers, insurers, and governments to deliver coaching, counselling, and therapy services across Australia.
We’re expanding our EAP provider network and hiring coaches, counsellors, and psychologists. Whether you’d like to supplement your private practice or take on a full-time career pathway, Intellect offers flexibility to fit your lifestyle.
Why Join Us?

• Flexibility in employment models: freelance, contracted, part-time, or full-time - so you can maintain your own private caseload/clients while expanding with Intellect

• Competitive compensation & attractive perks

• Minimal admin burden - we handle scheduling, billing, client matching

• Regular supervision & CPD included

• Diverse client base - from local employees to regional/global Fortune 500 companies

• Additional opportunities: CISP (Critical Incident Stress Programme), webinars, in-person seminars, clinical leadership

What You’ll Do

• Provide 1:1 telehealth and/or onsite coaching, counselling, or therapy-style consultations, offering general advice only (not treatment)

• Deliver CISP (Critical Incident Stress Programme) virtually or onsite as needed

• Facilitate webinars and in-person seminars (optional)

• Support employees with wellbeing, stress, and resilience

• Collaborate with Intellect’s internal clinical team to improve EAP programs

Must Haves
Counsellors & Clinical Psychologists
Counsellors:

• Master’s in Counselling or Counselling Psychology

• Active membership/registration with one of:

• ACA (Australian Counselling Association)

• PACFA (Psychotherapy & Counselling Federation of Australia)

• 1-3 years of supervised counselling experience (internship counts if part of licensure pathway)

Clinical Psychologists:

• Master’s in Clinical Psychology from an APAC-accredited program

• General registration with AHPRA (Psychology Board of Australia)

• Area of Practice Endorsement in Clinical Psychology preferred (or in progress via Registrar Program)

• 1-3 years of supervised clinical practice

Nice to Haves

• Experience working with First Nations / Aboriginal & Torres Strait Islander communities

• Background in managerial or leadership support (e.g., coaching managers, HR advisory)

• Prior EAP or workplace counselling experience

• Additional languages

• Flexibility for occasional onsite sessions

• Willingness for Police Check and/or Working With Children Check (not mandatory, only if requested by some clients)

• Eligibility/willingness to obtain a Medicare provider number (not mandatory, only if required by engagement type)

Let’s Talk
This is more than a job. It’s your chance to:

• Work with a global provider network

• Broaden your clientele base beyond local users

• Grow your career outside of sessions through research, content, and webinars

• Access supervision & CE most EAPs don’t provide

If you’re ready to make a meaningful impact and expand your practice with flexibility, we’d love to hear from you. Apply today and join Intellect in transforming workplace mental health across the country and beyond.

Expérience

• 2 à 5 ans d'expérience en vente technique, de préférence dans l'industrie chimique ou le traitement des eaux

• Expérience en prospection commerciale et gestion de portefeuille clients

• Connaissance des essais de laboratoire et des procédés de traitement

Compétences Techniques

• Maîtrise des produits chimiques de traitement des eaux

• Capacité à réaliser et interpréter des essais de traitabilité

• Excellente maîtrise d'Excel et des outils de gestion de données

Compétences Relationnelles

• Excellentes qualités relationnelles et de communication

• Capacité à vulgariser les aspects techniques complexes

• Autonomie et rigueur dans l'organisation du travail

• Esprit d'équipe et capacité d'apprentissage

Autres

• Mobilité géographique au QC

• Permis voiture

• Anglais technique souhaité

Rémunération

• Salaire fixe + bonus élevés selon profil

• Véhicule de fonction ou remboursement kilométrique

• Frais de déplacements pris en charge (hôtel, repas, etc.)

Avantages

• Formation approfondie assurée par un expert senior

• Évolution possible vers des fonctions de Direction après 1-2 ans

• Intégration dans une équipe dynamique et spécialisée

• Secteur d'activité stable et en développement

Localisation

• En télétravail avec possibilité d’avoir un bureau à Montréal (200 m métro Mt-Royal) et un 2 ieme bureau à Longueuil (2099 Fernand-Lafontaine)

• Déplacements fréquents dans les usines d'eau

ÉVOLUTION POSSIBLE

• Directeur des Ventes sous 1-2 ans (succession naturelle à terme)

title: Pessoa Engenheira de Inteligência Artificial Sênior
description:
Nosso propósito é criar tecnologias que desafiam as melhores do mundo e mudam o jogo para nossos clientes. Por isso, buscamos profissionais que desejam fazer parte de uma cultura pautada pela excelência e inovação. Se você se identifica com um ambiente de trabalho colaborativo e movido por curiosidade, venha construir o futuro da tecnologia conosco.
Valorizamos o crescimento contínuo dos zuppers, incentivando cada pessoa a trilhar caminhos que impulsionem sua evolução profissional.

Se você tem experiência profunda em IA, sabe como operacionalizar modelos e agentes em ambientes cloud e deseja ser protagonista na difusão do conhecimento para toda a comunidade de desenvolvimento, essa oportunidade é para você, buscamos uma pessoa apaixonada por Inteligência Artificial, com perfil técnico e habilidade em advocacy, para atuar no núcleo responsável por criar, evoluir e disseminar guardrails de segurança em IA! Trabalhe com tecnologias de ponta, ajude a proteger sistemas inteligentes e contribua ativamente com a cultura de segurança da nossa empresa.
O que você fará por aqui

• Projetar, desenvolver e implementar agentes de IA focados em soluções de segurança, utilizando frameworks e ferramentas líderes do mercado;

• Integrar e operacionalizar modelos de linguagem de grande porte (LLMs) e bases de conhecimento, automatizando e otimizando processos críticos através de Python e APIs modernas;

• Avaliar e sugerir alternativas em plataformas de GenAI (como AWS Bedrock, Azure AI, Google Vertex AI) para criação customizada de agentes inteligentes, considerando aspectos de escalabilidade e segurança;

• Implementar e consultar bancos de dados vetorizados (ex: Pinecone, Weaviate, Milvus, ChromaDB) para garantir armazenamento e recuperação eficiente de informações;

• Atuar como advocate de IA, promovendo treinamentos, talks e compartilhando boas práticas de segurança em IA para outros times de desenvolvimento;

• Automatizar processos de deploy e monitoramento de agentes e modelos em ambientes cloud, utilizando ferramentas como Docker, Kubernetes, Terraform e CI/CD.

O que esperamos que você saiba

• Programação avançada em Python.

• Experiência prática com LLMs: integração via API, avaliação de modelos e gerenciamento de contexto.

• Implementação de pipelines RAG com uso de vector databases (ex.: Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector) e frameworks como LangChain ou LlamaIndex.

• Domínio de técnicas de prompt engineering: few-shot, chain-of-thought, structured output e estratégias de instrução. Prompt Engineering

• Definição e aplicação de algoritmos sofisticados voltados a contextos de IA.

• Práticas de versionamento com Git: branching, code review e resolução de conflitos.

• Implementação e manutenção de pipelines CI/CD para aplicações back-end complexas.

• Utilização avançada de AWS para desenvolvimento, integração e monitoramento de soluções.

O que seria legal se você soubesse

• Conhecimento e experiência em Autorização e Autenticação Agênticas (Agentic Authorization/Authentication);

• Vivência prévia com ferramentas como Iara ou StackSpot;

• Participação ativa em comunidades, eventos ou publicações técnicas sobre IA aplicada à segurança;

• Desenvolvimento de integrações customizadas, plugins ou soluções de observabilidade inteligente;

• Familiaridade com soluções modernas de cache (ex: Redis, Memcached) focadas em IA;

• Certificações em Cloud, Segurança ou IA.

title: SAP Data Integration Consultant
description:
Bright Vision Technologies is a technology consulting and software development company delivering cloud, AI, data, and enterprise solutions across the United States. This is a fantastic opportunity to join an established and well-respected organization offering tremendous career growth potential.

Job Title: SAP Data Integration Consultant
Location: 100% Remote (U.S.)
Position Type: Full-time, Direct W2
Salary Range: $100,000-$150,000 Annually
Experience Required: 6+ years

Sponsorship: U.S. Citizens, Green Card Holders, EAD Holders, and H-1B transfer candidates are encouraged to apply. We are unable to sponsor new H-1B visa petitions for this position.

Job Summary
We are seeking an experienced SAP Data Integration Consultant to design, execute, and support large-scale data migration initiatives within SAP S/4HANA environments. This role focuses on the full data migration lifecycle - extraction, transformation, validation, reconciliation, and cutover - to ensure accurate, complete, and compliant migration of enterprise data from legacy systems into SAP.

Required Qualifications

• 6+ years of SAP data migration experience.

• Strong hands-on experience with SAP LTMC and S/4HANA migration tools.

• Experience with SAP SLT replication scenarios.

• Working knowledge of SAP LVM for system refresh and landscape management.

• Strong understanding of SAP master and transactional data structures.

• Experience performing data validation and reconciliation processes.

• Strong SQL and data analysis skills.

• Experience working in enterprise SAP landscapes during major implementations.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience participating in S/4HANA greenfield or brownfield implementations.

• Exposure to SAP Data Services or other ETL platforms.

• Experience with high-volume, multi-source data migrations.

• Working knowledge of SAP HANA database structures.

• SAP S/4HANA certification.

How to Apply

title: Account Manager – Out-of-Home (OOH)
description:

WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands. With exceptional talent, trusted data and intelligence, and world-class partnerships - all united by our pioneering agentic marketing platform, WPP Open - we help clients navigate change, capture opportunity, and deliver transformational growth. 

WPP Media is WPP's AI-driven media operating unit, bringing together media, data, and partnerships to deliver creative personalisation at scale. Connected through WPP Open and powered by Open Intelligence, clients see exactly where, how, and why their media investment is working.

For more information, visit wppmedia.com .

Key Responsibilities

• Develop OOH strategies based on client objectives, audiences, markets, locations, and the right mix of traditional and digital formats.

• Manage workflow, review team output, mentor junior staff, and serve as an escalation point.

Requirements

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.

• At least 3 years of experience in OOH planning, buying, investment, or activation.

• Strong knowledge of traditional and digital OOH formats, media owners, market research, location strategy, production, and measurement.

• Experience managing multi-market plans, RFPs, negotiations, budgets, campaign execution, billing, and reconciliation.

• Strong analytical, organizational, negotiation, presentation, and communication skills.

• Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, Word, and Outlook; familiarity with OOH planning and mapping tools is preferred.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities, solve problems proactively, and coach junior team members.

title: IT Specialist (f/m/d) 1st Level Server Support France
description:
At IONOS, the leading European provider of cloud infrastructure, cloud services and hosting services, you will work together with a wide range of teams. We are characterized by open structures, a friendly working culture and flat hierarchies with a strong team spirit. We firmly believe that work and fun are compatible, and offer you the right environment for this. Our constant growth means that we are always looking for new colleagues. Become part of IONOS and grow with us.

Your Responsibilities

To ensure an optimal experience and quality of service for our clients, we are looking to strengthen our dedicated French customer support team.

• First Point of Contact: Accompany clients in using our products and services, from understanding their initial request through to full resolution.

• Needs Analysis: Evaluate client inquiries to quickly identify their requirements and deliver clear, efficient, and tailored solutions.

• Technical Support: Assist clients with diverse technical issues and guide them through using our suite of products and services.

• Quality Communication: Maintain high standards of written and verbal communication, adapting your tone and technical level to each client's expertise.

• Value Addition: Identify relevant opportunities to introduce complementary products or services that genuinely fit client needs.

• Client Retention: Use your adaptability, patience, and customer-first mindset to drive customer satisfaction and loyalty.

• Team Collaboration: Work closely with colleagues and share knowledge to support the team's overall performance.

• Continuous Learning: Maintain autonomy and curiosity to stay up to date with evolving products, technologies, and internal tools.

Your profile

Are you passionate about IT and looking for your first professional role in a technical field, or do you want to further develop your skills?

We have a role for you!

• You have knowledge of UNIX/Linux environments such as Debian, Ubuntu, etc.

• You are familiar with LAMP development environments and/or web technologies and languages such as HTML, PHP, databases, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, etc.

• Curious about new technologies, you are keen to explore, experiment and discover the latest developments in the field of Artificial Intelligence (AI).

• You enjoy understanding problems, investigating their causes and finding solutions.

• You are dynamic and keen to play an active role in your team’s development.

• You are an excellent listener and are comfortable interacting with clients.

• You have very good communication skills, both spoken and written, and know how to adapt your approach to suit the person you are speaking to.

• You are patient, curious, adaptable and enjoy working as part of a team.

• You are comfortable with the commercial side of things and know how to identify a relevant solution or product whilst prioritising the client’s actual needs.

• Fluency in English and/or German would be an advantage.

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it.

We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.

- Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

- Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.

THE DATA CENTER OPERATIONS TEAM

The Data Center Operations team keeps Fluidstack's AI data centers running around the clock, operating the mechanical, electrical, and controls systems that keep gigawatt-scale infrastructure online for frontier AI workloads.

title: Accounting Manager
locationText: Goldsboro, North Carolina, United States; Pikeville +8 more
description:
Cobalt Service Partners

Cobalt Service Partners is a private equity-backed platform building a leading commercial access and security integration business in North America, backed by Alpine Investors and growing through acquisition across the country. We hire Accounting Managers on an ongoing basis to run accounting operations at our operating companies. This posting builds our national talent community: we may not have an opening in your exact market today, but we bring on Accounting Managers regularly as we grow, and when a role matches your background our recruiting team will reach out to talk through the specific business, market, and scope.

The Role

On-Site ·  Multiple U.S. Locations

Our Accounting Managers own the day-to-day accounting operation for a single operating company: the monthly close, internal and external reporting, controls, payroll oversight, and support of the annual audit. This is a hands-on, in-the-details role that partners closely with our regional finance team. Because our businesses are project-based, revenue recognition, job costing, and cash discipline sit at the center of the work. Scope and team size vary by operating company, and our recruiting team will walk you through the specifics when there is a match.

What You'll Own

• Close & reporting.  Run the monthly close, deliver a fast and accurate flash, and continuously improve the speed and accuracy of the process.

• Project accounting.  Manage revenue recognition and job costing for projects, and, where applicable, inventory management and cycle counts.

• Reporting & forecasting.  Prepare the financial package and variance analysis, and manage a 13-week forward-looking cash flow forecast.

• Maintain and improve controls, budgets, and KPIs, and keep regulatory compliance clean.

• Work in the operating company's ERP and support system implementations and integrations alongside the regional finance team.

• Where a team exists, manage and develop the accounting staff; ensure accurate payroll, AR, and AP.

What We're Looking For

• Roughly 5 to 8 years of progressive accounting experience, with genuine hands-on ownership of the monthly close.

• Strong command of GAAP, with fluency in reconciliations, accruals, and financial reporting.

• Experience running close and reporting across multiple entities, branches, or subsidiaries.

• Comfort in accounting systems (our operating companies run tools such as QuickBooks, Sage Intacct, and ServiceTitan) with the ability to learn and work in new ones.

• Strong Excel and data-modeling skills, and the self-direction to bring structure to ambiguity without hand-holding.

Preferred:  a public accounting foundation; project-based, construction, or inventory-heavy experience (job costing, WIP, cycle counts); prior experience supervising a small team; CPA.

Why Cobalt

• A high-growth, PE-backed platform where accounting is close to the business and your work drives real operating decisions.

• The chance to build and strengthen finance processes as we scale across a growing set of companies.

• Competitive base salary and performance-based bonus, benchmarked to your market and the scope of the seat.

• Full health benefits, 401(k) with match, paid time off, and professional development support.

title: Network Engineer
description:
SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge.  Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity. We operate with a flat organizational structure. All employees are expected to be hands-on and to contribute directly to the company’s mission. Leadership is given to those who show initiative and consistently deliver excellence. Work ethic and strong prioritization skills are important. All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.

 

About the Role

SpacexAI is building and operating large-scale networks that underpin training and inference infrastructure, including high-performance / supercompute fabrics that connect GPU clusters, plus the core, edge, and datacenter networks that keep that infrastructure reachable and reliable.

We need a Network Engineer who is strong on fundamentals and comfortable owning production network design, deployment, and operations end to end. This is a hands-on engineering seat - not a NOC technician role and not a network-software (telemetry/ZTP platform) SWE role. You will design and build networks, qualify platforms, ship changes safely, and keep availability and performance high as we scale.

Travel to Memphis (and other build sites) may be required for capacity build-outs. You will participate in a team on-call rotation.

Responsibilities

• Design, deploy, and operate production datacenter and campus/core networks at scale

• Own routing and switching configuration standards (BGP and at least one IGP such as OSPF or IS-IS), including change design, peer reviews, and execution

• Qualify new network platforms, optics, and topologies; contribute to architecture and capacity planning

•  Build and improve monitoring, alerting, and operational documentation so issues are caught and fixed quickly

•  Troubleshoot Layer 2/Layer 3 incidents end to end - from link flaps and optics through routing and traffic engineering - and drive root cause and lasting fixes

•  Automate repetitive network tasks with Python, Ansible, or similar tooling where it reduces toil

•  Partner with compute, facilities, and software teams during cluster build-outs and maintenance windows

•  Support high-performance / supercompute network environments (Ethernet AI/HPC fabrics, RoCE/RDMA-capable designs) as part of the broader network estate - deep specialist RoCE/NCCL ownership is a plus, not the bar for this seat

 

Basic Qualifications

•  Several years designing and/or operating production networks in a datacenter, ISP, cloud, or large enterprise environment

•  Solid hands-on experience with BGP and at least one interior routing protocol

• Working knowledge of TCP/IP, VLANs, EVPN/VXLAN or equivalent datacenter overlays, and optics / high-speed Ethernet

•  Experience troubleshooting live production network incidents and participating in on-call

• Strong written and verbal communication; clear change docs and incident notes

 

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Experience with modern datacenter vendors (e.g. Arista, Cisco, Juniper, Nvidia/Mellanox)

•  Familiarity with high-performance or supercompute networking (RoCEv2, congestion control, GPU cluster fabrics) - useful context for our environment, not a hard filter

•  Network automation (Python, Ansible, Terraform, or similar) used in production

•  Experience with EVPN, leaf-spine, and large-scale Ethernet fabrics

•  Prior work supporting rapid datacenter or cluster capacity build-outs

 

Additional Requirements

•  Willing to work onsite in Dublin

SpaceXAI is an equal opportunity employer. For details on data processing, view our Recruitment Privacy Notice .

title: Senior Maintenance Program Engineer
description:
Thanks for your interest in Oklo! We are searching for a senior maintenance program engineer to join our engineering team.

Position Description

At Oklo, we are building advanced nuclear systems that require disciplined, scalable maintenance programs to support safe, reliable plant performance.

We are seeking an experienced senior maintenance program engineer to own and drive the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of fleet maintenance standards across Oklo facilities. The engineer will establish maintenance requirements, technical bases, work-management practices, and system data that can be applied consistently while accommodating justified site-specific needs.

This is a high-impact role at the intersection of Facility Operations, Engineering, Maintenance, Supply Chain, Training, Quality, and digital systems. You will provide maintenance program leadership, translate approved strategies into executable work, and use equipment performance and operating experience to improve the program over time.

• Monitor schedule compliance, backlog health, preventive-maintenance completion, repeat maintenance, rework, and equipment reliability; use results, failures, corrective actions, and operating experience to drive improvements.

• Coordinate with Engineering, site teams, vendors, and Supply Chain on equipment bills of material, critical spares, stocking strategies, component availability, and obsolescence concerns.

• Develop and maintain procedures, templates, job aids, training inputs, controlled program records, and equipment history while coordinating fleetwide implementation across Facility Operations and partner organizations.

Minimum Qualifications:

• 10+ years of experience in the nuclear industry.

• Demonstrated experience in maintenance scheduling and in a maintenance leadership role.

• Strong understanding of nuclear plant operations and the interfaces among Operations, Maintenance, Engineering, Quality, Training, and Supply Chain.

• Experience developing, implementing, governing, or improving preventive, predictive, and corrective maintenance programs.

• Ability to develop defensible maintenance strategies and technical bases and translate them into executable work requirements.

• Experience with computerized maintenance management or enterprise asset management systems, asset hierarchies, equipment history, and maintenance master data.

• Strong technical writing, analytical, organizational, and cross-functional communication skills.

Bonus Qualifications:

• Experience standardizing maintenance programs across multiple nuclear facilities or units.

• Experience with equipment reliability, criticality analysis, failure-mode evaluation, corrective action, and operating-experience programs.

About Amperity -Why This, Why Now
Most customer data is a lie by omission.
Every consumer brand wants to know its customers. Unfortunately, almost none actually do. Data is scattered across a dozen systems, half of it contradicts the other half, and "insights" teams are forced to act on incomplete guesses. We started Amperity ten years ago because that gap-between what a brand believes about its customers and what is true-is the most expensive problem in the industry, and nobody had solved it.
With a lot of hard work and a little bit of luck, we did. Our patented identity resolution takes billions of messy, conflicting records and resolves them into an accurate picture of a real human being-in hours, not months. That’s not a feature; it’s the foundation everything else stands on. It’s why more than 400 brands-like Alaska Airlines, Wyndham Hotels & Resorts, DICK’S Sporting Goods, Virgin Atlantic, and Brooks Running-trust us with the one thing they can’t afford to get wrong, and why IDC named us a Leader in the category in 2026.
Now we’re doing something harder. We’re rebuilding Amperity as an AI-first company-not bolting a chatbot onto old software, but putting agents at the center of how customer data actually gets used. We shipped the industry’s first identity resolution agent, then the first enterprise Customer Data Agent that turns a plain-language question into a live segment without waiting on an engineering queue. The bet underneath all of it is simple, and we think it’s correct: The potential of AI will not be realized for a brand until it’s grounded and activated against a true, unified view of the customer. The market at-large is focused on intelligence, and we are focused on being the ones who can make it trustworthy.
So here’s the honest pitch. If you want a tour of a category that’s already been figured out, this isn’t it. If you want to help decide what the next version of an entire industry looks like-alongside people who are remarkably exceptional at what they do, solving a problem that requires deep, sustained focus-this is one of the few places that work exists. Our goal is to build a highly impactful, generational business.
We measure our success by one standard: whether what we build moves the business. Return on cognition, not return on hype. If that’s how you want to be measured, we would love to speak with you.
The Opportunity
We’re always eager to connect with driven and customer-focused sales professionals who are passionate about helping organizations unlock the full potential of their customer data. While we don't currently have an open position available, we’re growing and regularly hire for a range of sales roles.
At Amperity , our Sales team plays a pivotal role in shaping the company’s growth and success. From identifying opportunities and building lasting relationships to delivering strategic solutions that address complex business challenges, you’ll help prospects and customers discover the value of our platform and achieve their goals. Whether your strengths are in new business development, pre-sales solutions consulting, operations, enablement, business value consulting, or strategic partnerships, you’ll collaborate closely with prospects and customers to create meaningful impact.
If you’re interested in joining Amperity ’s Sales team but don’t see an opportunity that fits right now, please submit your resume. We’ll keep your information on file and reach out when we find a match!

Educational Assistant Program and Clinical Employee Reimbursement Program
401(k) with up to 4% match
Stock options
And much more!

The Director, Marketing Technology & Campaign Operations owns the technology, data, and operational engine that powers Arctic Wolf ’s global marketing organization - from the marketing technology (MarTech) stack and artificial intelligence (AI) roadmap through the campaign operations execution that turns strategy into delivered programs. This role sits on the Growth Services and Operations leadership team and reports directly to the VP, Growth Services and Operations.

The role also owns the operational engine that delivers campaigns on behalf of the teams that own strategy and pipeline targets, including Acquisition Marketing, Partner Marketing, Customer Marketing, and demand generation. This is a services and execution role for campaigns - it exists so the teams setting demand strategy have one reliable partner who builds, launches, and runs their programs to a high standard, on time, and within budget. This leader owns campaign execution across email, webinar, direct mail, and content syndication across the NAM (North America), EMEA (Europe, the Middle East, and Africa), and APAC (Asia-Pacific) regions and Arctic Wolf ’s sales plays, including the intake model, service level agreements (SLAs), build and QA standards, and the budget and MDF (market development funds) administration that keep the broader marketing organization moving without becoming a bottleneck.

This is a people-leadership-heavy role, managing a distributed team that spans marketing technology, database management, email and nurture strategy, and campaign operations, and a close partner to the Senior Director, Campaigns and Content and the teams that own demand and pipeline targets.

About this role

Toast is shifting from B2B powerhouse to consumer innovator. We're using our restaurant and guest data to make dining feel personal and frictionless, and with AI in the mix, we want discovery, booking, and dining to feel genuinely memorable.

You'll own reservations and booking end to end, from the messy, undefined version of the problem to the pixels that ship. Booking looks simple on the surface. It isn't. Making it feel easy is what this role is all about. You'll flex across other consumer surfaces when we need you there. 

You'd join a small, ambitious Consumer Design team that feels and operates like a startup within a larger company.  We have autonomy and the runway to reimagine dining and we all love to roll our sleeves up and jam together.

A day in the life (Responsibilities) 

Thinking

• Take an ambiguous problem and come back with a point of view and a prototype

• Design the whole loop, not just the booking screen

• Hold both sides in your head. A guest booking a table and a restaurant running a floor want different things

• Use behavioral data and guest feedback to shape what's next

Prototyping

• Build working prototypes fast, in whatever tool gets you there (Figma Make, Cursor, Replit, Magic Patterns, Lovable)

• Get something testable in front of people within days. Rough is fine, invisible isn't

• Run small experiments and think in phases

Craft

• Own visual and interaction quality end to end. Real opinions on type, spacing, hierarchy, motion

• Design native mobile and responsive web that holds up against the best apps people use

• Contribute to our design systems

Working together

• Partner closely with product, eng, research, and marketing

• Raise the bar for the designers around you through crit and pairing (not a management role, but a senior one)

• Advocate for the guest even when the pressure runs the other way, and explain why in terms the business cares about

• 5 to 7+ years designing consumer or consumer-grade products, with shipped work in your portfolio

• Range across native and responsive, guest-facing and operator-facing

• Bonus for scheduling, availability, transactional, or marketplace flow experience, or anything where a guest action has to land cleanly in someone else's operations

• Fluency with AI prototyping tools and Figma, with a strong handle on accessibility

• Solid UX fundamentals and the judgment to know which one a problem needs

How you use AI

We use these tools constantly, and we're specific about why. We want work that's better because of how you use AI: sharper concepts, more options explored, more of the unglamorous states actually designed. You know where it helps and where it produces confident mush.

Nice to haves

• You design in code, or close enough that engineers trust your handoff

• You've built or stewarded a design system

• You've shipped consumer at scale and know what breaks there

• Front-end and performance literacy. You know why your beautiful transition is dropping frames

• You're a tinkerer. You build things nobody asked for just to see if they'd work

AI at Toast

We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. title: Principal Software Engineer - Virtualization
description:

The Role:

General Motors is seeking a Principal Software Engineer to shape and scale the engineering platforms that build, test, integrate, validate, and deliver embedded software for software-defined vehicles. This role is for a hands-on technical leader who can turn ambiguous, cross-team problems into durable architecture, practical standards, and measurable improvements in engineering effectiveness, release confidence, and product quality.

• Ability to connect multiple initiatives together to deliver higher value.

• Demonstrated ability to work in an action-oriented decision-making environment.

• Strong Terraform/IaC experience with production‑grade module design.

title: Creative Director, Social
description:
At Yes&, bold creative is a calling card. And the best ideas start with understanding the audience, the business challenge, the cultural context, and what social can uniquely do.
The Creative Director, Social turns that understanding into ideas that earn attention, create connection, and give brands a distinctive presence.
The Creative Director, Social turns that understanding into ideas that earn attention, create connection, and give brands a distinctive presence. We’re looking for an exceptional conceptor and maker who can dig into a brief, ask the questions that make it better, and find the idea that brings it all together-then lead a team in making it great.
This is a creative leadership role built for social, with the expectation that you’ll stay both on and in the work.
Experience/Skills/Abilities Required:

• 10+ years of experience in creative direction, social creative, or integrated creative leadership within an agency or similarly fast-moving environment.

• A standout portfolio demonstrating bold social ideas, strong conceptual thinking, and beautifully executed work across platforms and formats.

• Exceptional conceptual skills, with a knack for finding the big idea inside a brief and turning business goals, audience insight, messaging, and strategy into distinctive, ownable creative.

• Deep understanding of social platforms, audience behaviors, creator dynamics, cultural context, and content formats, with strong instincts for what feels native without feeling predictable.

• Experience developing social creative platforms, campaigns, and content franchises that can flex across organic, paid, influencer, PR, and integrated programs.

• Strong writing, storytelling, and visual-thinking skills, with the ability to move between copy, scripts, storyboards, creative territories, prototypes, and other ways of bringing an idea to life.

• A maker mindset. You’re comfortable leading and doing-shaping the creative vision while getting into the work when it helps make the idea or execution stronger.

• Strong creative leadership skills, with the ability to inspire designers, writers, video teams, creators, and production partners from first thought through final execution.

• Strong client presence, with the ability to present the thinking behind the work, evolve ideas with senior stakeholders, and bring a compelling point of view to pitches and new business opportunities.

• A collaborative leadership style that brings creative, strategy, social, account, production, paid media, influencer, and PR teams together around one clear idea.

Other Requirements:

• You’re social-native, not social-only. You know what makes an idea work in-feed-and where a strong idea can travel beyond it.

• You’re curious about people, culture, brands, technology, creators, and whatever everyone will be talking about next.

• You know how to protect a big idea while letting it flex across platforms, formats, audiences, and channels.

• You’re comfortable embracing a brief, building on someone else’s thinking, and changing your own mind when the work gets better.

• You’re a generous creative partner with a clear point of view who makes the people and ideas around you stronger.

• You believe rigorous thinking and creative play belong together-and that the best social work can do more than fill a content calendar.

At Yes&, success means creating social work with a reason for being, an idea people can recognize, and enough creative energy to cut through without chasing every trend that passes by.
Bring us the brief, the audience insight, the impossible ask. Let’s find the idea that makes people care.

Required

title: Test Technician
description:
WHO WE ARE

Proxima Fusion is Europe’s fastest-growing fusion company and the continent’s best-funded fusion player, as well as the first spin-out from the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP). Backed by over €650M and powered by a growing team across Munich, Zurich, and Oxford, we are developing the hardware and infrastructure needed to deliver the world’s first commercial stellarator fusion power plant.

Our concept advances the most mature fusion technology out there, the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator, through two next-generation machines: Alpha and Stellaris. Our work combines stellarator optimization, advanced computation, machine learning, and high-temperature superconducting magnets to unlock higher-performance designs that were previously out of reach.

Turning these designs into a functioning fusion power plant requires excellence and ownership across every discipline, from physics and engineering to software, manufacturing, law, and business functions.

 

WHY JOIN PROXIMA FUSION

- You will get to work on some of the most complex tech challenges to bring abundant, safe, clean energy to the world.

- You'll get to join and learn from an exceptional selection of accomplished and driven individuals.

- Do your life’s best work and enjoy the journey.

- Get to show that big things are possible in Europe when you assemble the best talent.

 

YOUR IMPACT

At Proxima Fusion, we're developing the world's leading stellarator technology. To turn cutting-edge designs into reality, we need skilled technicians who can bring complex, first-of-a-kind hardware to life. As a Technician at Proxima Fusion, you'll work hands-on with Proxima-designed components, magnets, mechanical assemblies and other critical systems, supporting their build, assembly, integration and testing.

Working closely with Engineering, Manufacturing and Quality, you'll help turn ambitious designs into reliable hardware, solve practical challenges on the shop floor and contribute to developing the processes and tooling needed to build Alpha. This is a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of advanced engineering and hands-on manufacturing, helping build one of Europe's most ambitious engineering projects.

 

WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Run acceptance and characterization tests across incoming High Temperature Superconducting (HTS) tape, cables, intermediate assemblies, complete plate assemblies, and completed coils, supporting both development and production.

- Prepare and identify test articles by cutting, soldering, terminating, mounting, and fixturing in accordance with the test plan. Install sensors, voltage taps, feedthroughs and measurement wiring with careful grounding and shielding.

- Set up and operate dimensional inspection equipment, electrical instruments, high-current supplies, liquid-nitrogen baths, cryostats, cryocooler-based rigs and vacuum systems after training and authorization.

- Carry out critical-current and n-value measurements, joint-resistance, insulation-resistance and high-voltage insulation tests, plus visual and dimensional checks, using approved methods.

- Configure data acquisition and check connections, signal quality and instrument settings before each run. Follow test sequences precisely, monitor sample behavior and pause or stop at defined limits or unexpected conditions.

- Maintain full traceability of sample identity, test configuration, instrument settings, raw data, observations and deviations so that results and setups can be reproduced.

- Check data for completeness and plausibility, reduce and present results clearly, and compare them with defined acceptance criteria. Record all deviations, escalate suspect results or failures, and obtain approval before changing acceptance criteria.

- Troubleshoot test setups, wiring, instrumentation, and data acquisition. Distinguish test-article behavior from measurement faults, involving equipment technicians for machinery or rig repairs beyond approved routine care

title: Senior Manager, Fraud Strategy & Operations
description:
Raisin is the world’s leading platform for savings and investment products. Founded in 2012, the  FinTech connects consumers with banks in the EU, the UK and the US. This gives consumers better interest rates and banks a diversified form of refinancing . Our vision is to offer savings and investments without barriers and thus open up the global 160 trillion euro market.

Raisin currently employs more than 800 people from over 75 countries worldwide. Today, the platform holds over 80 billion euros in assets from  more than one million investors which have accrued over 5 billion euros in returns.

Team

The Fraud and Risk Operations team safeguards Raisin’s U.S. business by monitoring, detecting, and mitigating risks across the customer lifecycle. We manage fraud prevention, investigations, payments risk, fraud recovery, and while supporting 2nd line AML/KYC oversight. It partners closely with Product, Engineering, Compliance, and Customer Service to ensure safe and frictionless customer experiences. As a multi-bank deposit marketplace targeting rapid growth, Raisin faces complex, evolving multi-vector fraud challenges across onboarding, identity verification, bank linking, and money movement. Fraud and Risk Operations is at the center of designing the strategies, controls, and analytical foundations that protect the platform at scale.

Your Responsibilities

This role directly reports to the Head of Fraud Operations and is a senior expert role at Raisin US. We are looking for a Fraud Operations Specialist to assist in the design, building, and optimizing our fraud prevention and detection framework. In this role, you will be responsible for creating both predictive (pre-transaction/real-time mitigation) and detective (post-transaction/monitoring) rules within our risk platform. You will analyze emerging fraud patterns, balance fraud mitigation with user friction, and collaborate with product, engineering, payments, service and other allied teams to protect the Raisin platform and its customers while optimizing transaction approval rates.

Predictive & Preventative Strategy (Real-Time Rules)

• Real-Time Rule Authoring: Design, test, and deploy real-time logic within the risk rules engine (e.g., velocity checks, device fingerprinting triggers, IP risk thresholds, and behavioral anomalies, etc.) to intercept fraudulent actions during the entire customer lifecycle.

• Risk Model Integration: Partner with internal and external platform partners to integrate, build and implement both customer and transaction level fraud scores into the rules engine, creating conditional logic that automatically approves, blocks, or challenges high-risk events.

• Friction Optimization: Monitor and optimize false positive rates to ensure legitimate customer transactions pass through with minimal friction.

Detective & Post-Transaction Strategy (Monitoring & Analysis)

• Behavioral & Batch Monitoring: Build detective monitoring rules, threshold alerts, and transaction reports to identify complex fraud patterns, first party fraud triggers, account takeover, synthetic ID, or coordinated fraud rings after events occur.

• Chargeback & Loss Root-Cause Analysis: Conduct post-mortems on confirmed fraud instances and Reg E disputes to identify gaps in existing rule sets and rapidly deploy backtest-verified countermeasures.

• Rule Performance Tuning: Regularly review, backtest, and refine active rules to eliminate stale logic, reduce redundancy, and adapt to shifting fraud tactics. Utilize the iterations of rules to also actively monitor the existing customer book. 

• Rules and telemetry expansion: Active work internally and externally to seek additional risk signals, and proactively deploy to stay ahead of emerging fraud patterns.

Fraud Strategy & Operations

• Responsible for partnering with the Head of Fraud to own and execute Raisin’s U.S. fraud strategy across onboarding, account linking, and payment flows.
